headline: Citi Considers Offering Banking Services in Venezuela After 5 Years Since Exit
summary: Citigroup is studying a return to offering banking services in Venezuela five years after leaving the country, a move that could help restore Venezuela's access to the US financial system, Bloomberg reported.
why: Citigroup is one of the largest US global banks, and its re-entry decisions affect correspondent banking access and cross-border finance for emerging markets.
original_headline: Citi estudia ofrecer servicios bancarios en Venezuela tras 5 años de su salida
